title: Amazing guided tour of Cathedral and Alcazar
text: I did the guided tour today with a guide called Miguel. He was a very lovely man and informative. He introduced himself to everybody and made sure everyone knew who he was. He knew a lot of information about both the Cathedral and the Alcazar and answered all our questions. He knew great English and made me really want to book for another tour before heading home. Would highly recommend the guided tour!
author: amyblackmore00

title: Alcázar tour only
text: After a hassle trying to book on-line from the USA, we went with Pancho Tours for an Alcázar-only visit at 9:30am. Although the cost of the tour and admission was quite high ($75 for us both,) our guide, Lena (sp?) could not have been better. Witty, interactive and attentive, she supplied details which the guidebooks and placards do not include. After the tour, we were free to wander the Alcázar which we did for four hours. Sadly, we could not get to the upstairs residences. But if you stand crowds and love history or architecture, this is worth the time and expense.
author: dannybrown1793
